categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Bohui Innovation Biotechnology Group operates primarily in two segments: in vitro diagnostics (IVD) and biopharmaceuticals. The IVD segment focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of diagnostic instruments and reagents, including microelement detection systems and HPV detection systems. The biopharmaceutical segment mainly produces and sells blood products and vaccines through subsidiaries such as Hebei Bohui and Guangdong Weilen.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages microfluidic chip technology for fully automated nucleic acid molecular detection, especially in HPV testing. It also employs atomic absorption spectroscopy and inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) for microelement detection. Blood products are manufactured using plasma fractionation and recombinant DNA technology, adhering to GMP standards and strict quality control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include hospitals, third-party clinical laboratories, environmental testing agencies, and research institutions. The IVD products serve clinical diagnostic markets, focusing on disease prevention and diagnosis, while biopharmaceutical products target clinical treatment sectors, including oncology, immunology, and infectious diseases. The company also serves non-medical users through its US subsidiary Advion in mass spectrometry applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with key regional markets including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It also has international operations through its US subsidiary Advion Inc and its sales subsidiaries in the UK, Japan, and India. Major production bases and plasma collection stations are located in Hebei, Guangdong, Inner Mongolia, and Yunnan provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bohui Innovation operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures diagnostic instruments, reagents, and biopharmaceutical products, while also managing plasma collection through its own plasma stations, which supply raw materials for blood product manufacturing. The company sells finished products directly to medical institutions and through distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment focused on expanding molecular diagnostics product lines, including HPV genotyping and respiratory pathogen detection kits. It aims to enhance automation, sensitivity, and ease of use in diagnostic systems. In biopharmaceuticals, it focuses on expanding plasma collection capacity, improving production efficiency, and developing new blood product varieties such as coagulation factors and immunoglobulins.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of diagnostic instruments, reagents, and biopharmaceuticals. Sales channels include direct sales to hospitals and third-party labs, as well as distributor networks. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the IVD sector, the company competes with multinational giants like Roche, Abbott, Danaher, and Siemens, but holds a leading position domestically in microelement detection and HPV testing. In blood products, it competes with major domestic players such as Tiantan Biological, Shanghai RAAS, Hualan Biological, and Taibang Biological. The company is recognized as a significant player with growing plasma collection capabilities and a broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 851.7 million, a decline of 18.53% from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 9.25 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. Total assets reached RMB 4.13 billion, with steady growth in asset base and plasma collection stations. The company invests over 10% of revenue in R&D, reflecting a commitment to innovation despite recent revenue pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bohui Innovation emphasizes its fully automated microfluidic nucleic acid detection technology as a domestic first in HPV testing, offering high sensitivity and operational convenience. Its integrated instrument-plus-reagent closed systems provide reliable and comprehensive diagnostic solutions. In biopharmaceuticals, the company highlights its extensive plasma collection network and diversified product range covering key blood products, ensuring quality and supply security. The company also stresses its strong R&D capabilities and quality management systems as competitive advantages.
